title: Bregman Consensus
abstract: arXiv:2609.35930v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Consider a community of agents who are seeking consensus on a set of parameters. The agents agree to use the same Bregman-type divergence to quantify disagreement between their individual estimates of the parameters but have varying confidence in each other's abilities. Each agent is happy to revise their estimate by moving to the weighted barycenter of all individual estimates with higher weights applied to more trusted agents. We show that such revisions naturally lead to an iterative algorithm which converges to a unique consensus estimate of the parameters. Furthermore, since the consensus estimate is itself a barycenter with computable weights, the group emerges as a collective super-agent with a well-formed opinion regarding the ability of each individual agent.

translated_abstract: 考虑一个由多个智能体组成的群体，它们寻求就一组参数达成共识。这些智能体约定使用同一种 Bregman 型散度来量化彼此对参数个体估计之间的分歧，但它们对彼此能力的信任程度各不相同。每个智能体都乐于通过移动到所有个体估计的加权重心来修正自己的估计，其中被更信任的智能体会被赋予更高的权重。我们证明，这样的修正过程自然地引出一种迭代算法，该算法收敛到参数的唯一共识估计。此外，由于共识估计本身就是一个具有可计算权重的重心，整个群体便形成一个集体“超级智能体”，对每个个体智能体的能力持有明确且良定义的看法。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于 Bregman 散度加权重心的迭代修正算法，使一群相互信任程度不同的智能体收敛到唯一的参数共识估计，并使整个群体如同一个对各成员能力有明确评估的“超级智能体”。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that iteratively revising individual estimates toward a Bregman-divergence weighted barycenter leads a group of agents with varying mutual trust to converge to a unique consensus, with the group emerging as a collective super-agent holding well-formed opinions about each member's ability.
